## Expected and observed behavior

## Minimal reproduction

Include code/commands, template or structure, explicit units, timestep, seed,
backend and parameters. For topology errors include the snapshot versions.

## Environment and validation

OS/architecture, Rust version, Unity version (if used), LAMMPS source tag/build
configuration and header version (if used). Which tests were actually executed?

## Scientific assumptions

Is this an error relative to the documented approximation, or a request for a
more complete physical model? Do not attach private data or huge trajectories.
